name: The Hollow Lantern — Yard (Example)
ambient: (EXAMPLE AREA — PLACEHOLDER PROSE) A salt-stained lighthouse yard at dusk. The lamp above is dark, and the cistern grate below breathes cold air.

npcs.name: Ivy, the Lantern Keeper
npcs.look: (EXAMPLE NPC) A weathered woman in an oilskin coat trims the wick of a dead lamp. She does not look up when you approach.

objects.name: Watch Notice
objects.look: (EXAMPLE OBJECT) A nailed-up notice, its ink running in the damp: the lamp must be lit by full dark, and the cistern must not be opened after sunset.

interactions.label: Read the watch notice
interactions.success_text: (EXAMPLE) You read the notice. The last line has been scratched out and rewritten: 'It is already open.'

effects.text: (EXAMPLE) The notice names three keepers. Only Ivy's name is not struck through.

objects.name: Cistern Stairs
objects.look: (EXAMPLE OBJECT) A stone stair spirals down through the yard to the cistern. The air rising from it is colder than the evening.

entry_effects.text: (EXAMPLE CAMPAIGN) The yard gate closes behind you. Somewhere below, water moves.
